tool_input.command:
mkdir -p docs/policies && cat > docs/policies/tls-verification.md <<'EOF'
# TLS certificate verification

The project's current recorded decision is that TLS certificate verification is enabled on all builds, development builds included, with no exceptions; this sits alongside the recorded decision to use HTTPS everywhere, with no exceptions, so connections are always made over TLS and their certificates are always verified.
EOF
cat docs/policies/tls-verification.md
